configurePresets.name: dev-gcc
configurePresets.description: Default dev build. Pins BOTH C and C++ to gcc/g++ so the toolchain can't drift into the gcc/clang mix that breaks JUCE's warning flags. The most trodden JUCE-on-Linux path.

configurePresets.name: dev-clang
configurePresets.description: Optional Clang build (better diagnostics). Pins BOTH C and C++ to clang. Requires the clang package.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: GCC with AddressSanitizer + UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer for the model/diff logic. For ThreadSanitizer on the audio/message-thread boundary, switch inherits to dev-clang (TSan is stronger under Clang).

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc
configurePresets.description: Native Windows build for real low-latency audio (WASAPI/ASIO). Targets Visual Studio 2026 (v18, toolset v145) — needs CMake >= 4.2 (when the VS 18 2026 generator was added). For VS 2022 use generator 'Visual Studio 17 2022'. Run from a Windows shell, not WSL.

configurePresets.name: macos-clang
configurePresets.description: Native macOS build for real low-latency audio (CoreAudio). Unlike the dev presets this does NOT pin a compiler: on Darwin, CMake already resolves cc/c++ to Xcode's AppleClang, whereas hard-pinning bare 'clang' would grab a Homebrew LLVM if one shadows it on PATH — the opposite of the drift the pinning elsewhere prevents. Inherits base's Ninja generator rather than the Xcode one, which needs a full Xcode.app and not just the Command Line Tools. Needs: brew install cmake ninja. ASIO is Windows-only, so none of that SDK wiring applies here.
